rows.grounds: locative singular of netra-udyota, the eye's illumination; marks the chapter's setting
compound viṃśa + adhikāra, twentieth chapter; @ marks sandhi fusion of viṃśaḥ + adhikāraḥ

items.question: What chapter does this colophon mark within the Netra's illumination?
premises: netrodyote names the eye's illumination as the setting
the two tokens form a chapter colophon
items.inference: This verse is a colophon marking the twentieth chapter of the Netratantra.
uncertainties: recension numbering may differ; M00038 compressed witness
items.plain_english: In the illumination of the Netra, the twentieth chapter.
